# Lodgify

Lodgify is an all-in-one vacation rental software that enables property owners and managers to create bookable websites, synchronize property data across multiple channels, and manage guest reservations and communications from a single platform.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/lodgify/.

## Actions

- **Get Property Availability** (read-only): This tool retrieves the availability information for a specific property.
- **Get Countries** (read-only): Retrieve all available countries.
- **List Channel Connections** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all channel connections.
- **List Channel Mappings** (read-only): List channel mappings.
- **List Channel Reservations** (read-only): List channel reservations.
- **List Channels** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all channels.
- **List Properties** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of properties.
